# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen (in autumn of Volume 1) / Around fifteen to sixteen  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall boy with an ungainly, athletic build and hazel eyes. He has curly brown hair and a teasing, roguish smile. He is widely considered very handsome by his peers.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

Gilbert is confident, mischievous, and fond of teasing girls. Despite his mischievous streak, he is stout-hearted, honorable, and quick to admit his mistakes when he realizes he has offended someone. He is academically ambitious, competitive, and good-natured in rivalry.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## Traits

- Handsome  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- Mischievous and teasing  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- Contrite and honorable when wrong  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>
- Academically ambitious  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

## Abilities

- Excellent student and scholar  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- Talented at mental arithmetic and spelling  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032)</sub>
- Recitation  <sub>[v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040)</sub>

## Goals

- To excel in his studies and achieve academic honors  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- To make peace with Anne Shirley and earn her friendship  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to Avonlea after spending three years in Alberta with his sick father, falling behind in his school progression as a result. Upon his return to the Avonlea school, he quickly resumed his position at the top of his class. On his first day back, he attempted to get the attention of Anne Shirley by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots,' causing her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Although Gilbert publicly took the blame for the incident and apologized to Anne at the school door, she refused to forgive him. On a later occasion, when the master punished Anne by forcing her to sit with Gilbert, he tried to comfort her by offering her a candy heart, which she crushed under her shoe. Despite Anne's coldness and grudge against him, Gilbert maintained a good-natured academic rivalry with her throughout their time in the Fourth and Fifth classes. By the end of the term, he was promoted with her into the fifth class to study Latin, geometry, French, and algebra. After years of rivalry, Gilbert gave up his application for the Avonlea school so that Anne could teach there and stay with Marilla, opting instead to teach at White Sands. Upon learning of his sacrifice, Anne forgave him and they finally became close friends.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## Background by volume

- Spent three years living in Alberta with his father due to the latter's health before returning to Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Quotes

> It was my fault Mr. Phillips. I teased her.  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)</sub>

> I’m awfully sorry I made fun of your hair, Anne. Honest I am. Don’t be mad for keeps, now.  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

> It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?  <sub>[v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

> We are going to be the best of friends. We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways.  <sub>[v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)</sub>
